scope: Independent read-only product review; only this review artifact written. No deployment, provider, wallet or database calls.

checks.candidateIdentity: Final HTML 7a99bd3c75d623f24c3c8807cadeaa5b670258ab3345f713f0136792c77ecac2 verified. Delta from prior reviewed candidate adds overflowWrap=anywhere to buy/sell result elements only.

checks.backend: Read api_create_order, api_sell_create, json_object, sell_order_create and cancel_pending. Explicit handler HTTP 400/403/429 paths occur before create. Structured SELL ok:false is explicit rejection; one path creates then cancels an unmarked order.

checks.browserSource: Current runner exercises 48 synthetic cases across buy/sell and two widths, native DOM/XSS, acknowledgement, no automatic repeat and unchanged success. Not independently executed by this reviewer.
checks.writerStatus: Host obsidian-roadmap-autopilot.service reports failed (inactive); initial sandbox bus access denial was retried through approved host command.
checks.narrowViewportDelta: Reviewed both result elements setting overflowWrap=anywhere. This addresses long literal token overflow while retaining textContent, classification and POST behavior. Focused tests rerun; native browser layout rerun belongs to primary.

findings.summary: SELL structured rejection is not uniformly precreation. Missing-marker branch cancels after create and ignores cancel_pending CAS return.
findings.assessment: Current contract distinguishes HTTP precreation errors from structured explicit rejection; changed UI makes no absence claim for structured rejection. Backend cancellation race remains outside this unchanged-backend slice; no live incident or concurrency failure reproduced.

limitations: Native browser execution is owned by primary; this review validates runner source only.
VM tests use synthetic captured requests and do not prove production order persistence.
Real Telegram/iOS/WebKit, assistive technology and human comprehension acceptance remain open.
Deferred wallet preparation/signature concurrency findings are a separate follow-up.
